'''Kabu''' (Japanese: '''カブ''' ''Kabu'') is the [[Gym Leader]] of [[Motostoke]]'s [[Gym]], known officially as [[Motostoke Stadium]]. He [[Type expert|specializes]] in {{type|Fire}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. He gives the {{badge|Fire}} to Trainers who defeat him.

==In the core series games==
Kabu is designated the third [[Gym Leader]] [[Galar]] {{pkmn|Trainer}}s face in their [[Galar League|Gym Challenge]]. However, Kabu is also known to be the first real challenge in the Gym Challenge. Often, Trainers give up due to being unable to defeat him. Kabu, after being scouted as a [[Pokémon Trainer]], moved from [[Hoenn]] to [[Galar]].<ref>Kabu: ''I moved from Hoenn to Galar because I got scouted.''

[[Middle-Aged Opposites]]</ref> He is the current Leader of the [[Motostoke Stadium|Motostoke Gym]]. He lost the Gym position at one point but regained back several years later in glorious fashion.<ref>https://swordshield.pokemon.com/en-us/people-galar-region/fire-gym-leader-kabu/</ref> He made several attempts to becoming {{pkmn|Champion}} but could never reach it. He attempted a no-holds-barred approach to winning his fights but was not satisfied with the results. He even dropped to the minor division of Galar League. However, after facing off against [[Leon]], he regained faith in his potential. He also developed a more unrelentingly positive outlook on life as a result, battling to win with every intention with his {{type|Fire}} Pokémon. He is shown doing athletic activities like jogging throughout the game.

Kabu is first seen at Motostoke Stadium for the Gym Challenge's opening ceremony. The {{player}} and [[Hop]] first meet him in [[Galar Mine No. 2]], defeating a pair of {{tc|Team Yell Grunt}}s who were disturbing the local [[wild Pokémon]]. He explains to the two young Trainers that he sometimes visits the mine to train against the {{type|Water}} Pokémon that live there, before returning to his Gym. After being defeated, Kabu is joined by [[Milo]] and [[Nessa]] at [[Motostoke]]'s front gate as he recites a cheer for the player and Hop to wish them good luck for the rest of their Gym Challenge. Kabu later participates in the Champion Cup at [[Wyndon]], but is defeated by [[Piers]] in the first round. He also participates in the post-game [[Wyndon Stadium/Champion tournaments|Champion tournaments]] and the [[Galarian Star Tournament]].

After Kabu's initial defeat, the player is awarded with the {{badge|Fire}}, {{TM|38|Will-O-Wisp}}, and the [[List of clothing in Pokémon Sword and Shield|Fire Uniform]].

===League Cards===
This is a transcript of the back of Kabu's [[League Card]]s in {{g|Sword and Shield}}.
;Normal League Card
:"Kabu is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] who was invited from the [[Hoenn]] region. There were a few times where he was very close to becoming {{pkmn|Champion}}, but victory always seemed to elude him at the last moment. Because of this, he adopted a no-holds-barred approach to {{pkmn|battle|battling}} for a time, but even that did not bring the results he wanted. He even dropped to the minor division at one point, but after a fantastic battle with [[Leon]], he regained faith in his own potential. His motto is to keep learning and training as long as he is alive."
;Rare League Card
:"Interview with Challenger Kabu<br>Q: How do you see your own battle style?<br>Kabu: "Just, straightforward, direct. I'm still young, so I try to keep things simple. Just burn as hot as I can, you know? Still, I've hit a bit of a losing streak, so I've tried incorporating {{m|Will-O-Wisp}} into my Pokémon's move set. That's one thing I want to tell everyone—experiment with every possibility of your Pokémon. [[Move]]s, [[Ability|Abilities]], [[item]]s... Try everything, and there's sure to be a path forward!"

==In animation==
[[File:Kabu anime.png|thumb|250px|Kabu in {{aniseries|HZ}}]]
===''Pokémon Horizons: The Series''===
Kabu made his debut at the end of ''[[HZ019|The Bittersweet Truth]]'', where he was seen eating at the Motostoke [[Battle Café]]. In the [[HZ020|next episode]], he made his way to [[Motostoke Stadium]] where [[Liko]] and [[Roy]] joined him to ask about the [[Black Rayquaza]]. Wanting to assist the two young Trainers, he, Kabu had them undergo a {{pkmn|training}} session that helped them find new methods of using their Pokémon's most basic [[Move|attacks]] by using them to either light up or extinguish the flames of a group of {{p|Litwick}}.
[[File:Kabu Rayquaza flashback.png|thumb|250px|left|Kabu seeing the [[Black Rayquaza]]]]
After Roy had won the challenge, Kabu challenged the two to a [[Multi Battle]], with his {{tc|Gym Trainer}} apprentice {{OBP|Wakaba|HZ020}} as his partner. Kabu's {{p|Centiskorch}} easily overwhelmed both {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}} and {{TP|Roy|Fuecoco}}, even when the latter learned {{m|Flamethrower}} mid-battle. Once Fuecoco had been defeated, Kabu left the battle against Liko to Wakaba. After Liko's unexpected surrender, Kabu told her that while being kind and compassionate is a good thing, being compassionate to this degree during a battle can be disrespectful toward both the opponent and the participating Pokémon, as both Wakaba and Sprigatito were disappointed in her not finishing the battle in earnest. When Liko and Roy later left, Kabu encouraged Liko to find her own path in life.

In ''[[HZ023|Fiery Galarian Moltres]]'', Kabu went to the [[Galar Mine]] to investigate the reports of a collapse that happened there. Upon arriving there, he found Liko, Roy, and [[Friede]], who revealed that the chaos had been caused by a {{rf|Galarian}} {{TP|Lucius|Moltres}}. When they left, Kabu realized that Friede was trying to hide {{an|Terapagos|something}}, but simply smiled and let them go.

Kabu appeared in a flashback to Liko and Roy's journey in ''[[HZ045|From So Far Away]]''.

Kabu reappeared in a flashback in ''[[HZ085|The Pokémon Paradise of Laqua!]]''.

====Character====
Kabu was shown to be a very wise and mature person, highly respected in his hometown. He is shown doing athletic activities like jogging throughout the anime. He also gave Liko several pieces of advice on how to train her {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}}.
{{-}}

==In the manga==
[[File:Kabu Adventures.png|thumb|120px|Kabu in Pokémon Adventures]]
===Pokémon Adventures===
Kabu debuted in ''[[PASS03|Chomp!! Defeat Drednaw]]''. He, along with various other Gym Leaders, was first seen reacting to the news that [[Leon]] had endorsed two {{pkmn|Trainer}}s for the [[Galar League|Gym Challenge]]. 

In [[PASS10|Blazing!! Bede's Feelings]], Kabu was revealed to have faced [[Marnie]] in a Gym battle, but lost. He later faced [[Bede]], {{Henry}}, {{Casey}}, and [[Hop]] in Gym battles, which he also lost. After Hop's victory, Kabu, [[Milo]], and [[Nessa]] personally congratulated him and Casey for completing the first three Galar Gyms.

In ''[[PASS25|Rumble!! The Horrific Darkest Day]]'', the Galar Gym Leaders gathered at [[Rose Tower]] to find out if [[Rose]] intended on bringing harm to the region. While [[Oleana]] kept the Gym Leaders busy, Henry, Casey, Bede, Hop, and Marnie went up to meet Rose, only find he was elsewhere. On a video screen, Rose announced his intention to restart the [[Darkest Day]] and ensure the safety of Galar's future. Power Spot lights began appearing all over the region, causing Pokémon to start [[Dynamax]]ing at random. While some traveled to confront Rose at the [[Hammerlocke]] [[Energy Plant]], Kabu went back to Motostoke to help deal with the rampaging Dynamax Pokémon.

In ''[[PASS29|GRRR!! The Irrepairable Gears]]'', [[Macro Cosmos]] employees were dispatched to deal with the Dynamax Pokémon, allowing Kabu's group to provide backup for the others against {{p|Eternatus}}. By the time they arrived, Kabu's group found Eternatus had fled, leaving those who battled it unconscious and covered in poison. The injured were taken to a hospital to recover.

By ''[[PASS40|Rumble!! The Darkest Day Returns]]'', the others had fully recovered from Eternatus's poison and were discharged from the hospital. Kabu and the others then set off to help stop the Darkest Day, which had begun once again.
{{-}}

It was later seen facing [[Casey Shield|Casey]]'s {{p|Arrokuda|Kilo}} in its [[Gigantamax]]ed form, but was defeated as well. It later fought [[Oleana]]'s {{p|Milotic}} at [[Rose Tower]].

None of Centiskorch's moves are known.}}
Kabu has at least two other Pokémon, as he participated in a three-on-three Gym battle against {{Henry}}.

==Trivia==
[[File:Company Icon Huo Guo Hot Pot.png|thumb|150px|Icon of Huo Guo Hot Pot, Kabu's sponsor]]
* Kabu was designed by [[take]].<ref name=takeSWSHCharDesign>[https://twitter.com/_take_oekaki/status/1565902892774871040 Tweet about designing all of the Gym Leaders for Pokémon Sword & Shield]</ref>
* Kabu's uniform number is "187", which can be read in Japanese as {{wp|Numeric substitution in Japanese|goroawase}} for 火花 ''hibana'', meaning "sparks".
* Kabu's sponsor is Huo Guo Hot Pot, whose logo can be seen on his shorts.
* Kabu is the only [[Gym Leader]] in [[Galar]] to:
** Originally be from [[Hoenn|another region]].
** Have their English name be the same as their Japanese name.
* Kabu was the first Gym Leader introduced before [[Generation IX]] to appear in ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]''.
